caption.description: Optional header band above the canvas describing what the diagram is. Omit for the bare canvas.

groups.description: Explicit containers for arbitrary topologies. When omitted, a single AWS Cloud → VPC → public/private subnet tree is derived from each service's `subnet`.

direction.description: Layout flow direction: LR (left→right, default) or TB (top→bottom).

lang.description: Language the content is authored in (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'en', 'pt', 'es'). Default 'en'. The UI chrome (modal headings, tooltips) adapts to it.

languages.description: Offer a language switch in the toolbar. List every language you provide text for — ANY ISO 639-1 code works, not just en/pt (e.g. ['en','es','ja','fr']). When set with >1 entry, ALL author text fields (title, subtitle, service/role, group label, step title/eyebrow/body/badge, bullets, chips, sections) may be a per-language map { en: '…', ja: '…' } instead of a plain string, and the toolbar lets the viewer switch. Omit for single-language diagrams.

uiStrings.description: Localize the built-in UI chrome (toolbar tooltips + node-modal headings) for languages beyond the built-in en/pt/es — keyed by UI key then language, e.g. { cost: { ja: '料金見積もり' }, restart: { ja: 'ウォークスルーを再開' }, theme: { ja: 'テーマ切替' } }. Keys: iac, pricing, architecture, restart, play, pause, theme, collapse, expand, language, cost. Any (key,lang) you omit falls back to the built-in table, then English. Only needed when you use a language the built-in chrome doesn't cover.

langLabels.description: Display label for each language's toolbar switch button, e.g. { en: 'EN', ja: '日本語', 'zh-CN': '中文' }. Defaults to a built-in for en/pt/es/fr/de, else the uppercased code.

steps.description: Guided walkthrough beats. Arrow keys / the dock's play button step through them; each shows an overlay card and can tint+zoom a subset of the diagram.

stepZoom.description: When steps are present, glide the camera onto each beat's `zoom` (or `nodes`). Default off.

startStep.description: Which beat the diagram opens on: -1 (default) shows the whole-diagram overview first; 0+ opens directly on that beat, so a wide/dense diagram lands already zoomed into a legible region instead of a tiny fit-all view (requires stepZoom to actually frame it).

startCardScale.description: Initial text-size step (0–3, default 0) the walkthrough card opens at — set 1–3 to start with a LARGER card; the A−/A+ toolbar buttons still adjust from there.

stepFocus.description: When steps are present, hide non-active nodes each beat to isolate it. Default off (dim instead of hide).

flowDots.description: Animate a dot travelling along each connection to convey flow direction. Default true. Set false for a static, print-friendly look (arrowheads only, no motion).

collapsible.description: Show a fold toggle (▸/▾) on every group header so the viewer can collapse/expand containers (d3-zoomable-treemap style); collapsing a group hides its children, shrinks it to a small box, and re-runs the layout. Default true.

tabs.description: Turn the output into a MULTI-TAB document (tab rail + panels, like the cost-calculator app) instead of a bare canvas: one tab holds the live architecture (kind='architecture'), others hold the animated UML sequence (kind='sequence') or prose (kind='doc'). Omit for the classic single-view diagram.

sequence.description: Shortcut for the common two-view document: pass the architecture as usual plus a `sequence`, and a two-tab rail (Architecture + Sequence) is generated automatically — no `tabs` needed.

defaultCollapsed.description: Group ids that start COLLAPSED on load — good for a dense diagram whose overview should read clean, letting the viewer expand only what they need (e.g. ['vpcdados']).

flowPeriod.description: Uniform flow-dot period in seconds: every edge's dot shares this exact period (instead of the default staggered timing) so a GIF captured over `flowPeriod` seconds via render_diagram_media loops seamlessly.

costUrl.description: Link to an external cost estimate (e.g. an AWS Pricing Calculator share URL). Adds a 'Cost estimate' button to the toolbar dock that opens it in a new tab. Only a link — this server does not price anything. When omitted, the first walkthrough step with a `costUrl` is used.

costLabel.description: Label for the dock's cost button (default: the localized 'Cost estimate').

titleBehavior.description: Let the title get out of the way: hide the dock title and/or the caption band always, or after an interaction / a timeout / while the walkthrough runs.

mode.description: always (default): the title stays; hidden: never shown; auto: hidden after the trigger.

trigger.description: auto mode: first pointer/wheel/key interaction (default), a timeout, or while a walkthrough beat is active.

target.description: What hides: the dock title and/or the caption band (default ['dock']). The presentation mode (F) hides both.

restoreOnHover.description: Show the dock title again while the pointer is over the dock.

startCollapsed.description: Open with the dock collapsed to its small ▲ button.

costs.description: Several estimate links — one per environment or sizing scenario. The dock shows the selected environment's (the `default` entry first) as a split button whose menu lists the others and switches the environment (step pills with cost "@env" and the node modal's per-environment pricing follow; the choice is kept in the URL as #env=…). costUrl/costLabel stay as a shortcut for a single entry. Links only — nothing is priced.

label.description: Button / pill / menu label, e.g. 'Production estimate'.

default.description: The estimate the page opens on (at most one).

showTitle.description: Show the title/subtitle in the toolbar dock. Default true. false hides them in the dock only; the HTML <title>, the share-card PNG and the sidecar JSON keep them (useful when a `caption` band or the host page already shows the title).

data.description: App-shell inputs (layout shell 'app'): initial values form cards edit and formulas read. Ignored by the document page.

metrics.description: App-shell formulas by name over `data` and other metrics: JSON expressions ({ ref } / { op, args }), never code. Ignored by the document page.

layout.description: Which components the page shows, where, and how it looks: a preset ('default', 'cost'), a saved layout name (see list_layouts), or an inline layout { extends?, slots?, patch?, theme?, branding? }. Omit for the standard page (identical to before layouts existed).
